question: A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 25% above its cost price and offers a 16% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of ₹140, then what is the list price (in ₹) of the fan?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100 units ⇒ List Price (MP) = 125 units.

Selling Price (SP) after 16% discount = 125 × 0.84 = 105 units.

Profit = SP − CP = 105 − 100 = 5 units.

Given, 5 units = ₹140 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹28.

List Price (MP) = 125 × 28 = 3500.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3500.**
